entry.title: New: Resolution 535 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT FOR MAINTENANCE AND/OR IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS AT VARIOUS PARK FACILITIES AND POOLS IN COUNCIL DISTRICT 1

Transfers $12,850 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 1)
